Method of Attack: Spreads via malicious Excel 4.0 macros that download the ransomware directly on the system
Delivered via spam campaigns with malicious Excel 4.0 macro attachments
Uses old Excel 4.0 macros (XML-based) to evade detection and directly download payload without intermediary downloader
Impacted Systems: Systems running Microsoft Office supporting Excel 4.0 macros
Attack Vector: Malicious email campaigns with Excel 4.0 macro-laced documents (ZIP archives)
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with ZIP archive named 'Official notification' containing Excel 4.0 macro
Ransomware sample downloaded directly by macro
